name: annual-reviews
description: Write annual performance reviews and self-reviews from your performance notes. Evidence-backed strengths and growth areas, rubric mapping, and bias checks for existing drafts.

interface.longDescription: Helps managers and employees write annual performance reviews. Paste your performance notes, goals, or feedback and get a Manager Review Draft for a direct report or a Self-Review Draft for yourself. Every strength and growth area is tied to an evidence ledger, mapped to your company's rubric when you provide one, and paired with measurable development actions. Already have a draft? The Review Audit checks it for period coverage, attribution, evidence quality, and biased language. Missing dates, metrics, or examples are flagged as gaps instead of being made up. The person writing the review keeps every decision: it does not assign ratings or make promotion, compensation, or termination calls. Built from the Annual Reviews playbook at andrewluxem.com. Static skill: no network calls.
capabilities: Draft an annual performance review for a direct report
Draft your own self-review from your notes
Audit a review draft for evidence gaps and biased language
defaultPrompt: Turn these performance notes into my self-review
Draft an annual review for my direct report
Check this performance review for bias
